title: The Promise of the Angel and the Entry into Canaan
description: God promises to send His angel ahead of Israel to lead them into the promised land. He will gradually drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, set their boundaries from the Sea of Zin to the Philistine sea, and bless the people with health and fertility if they obey His voice and do not make covenants with the nations or their gods.
